Presealed minimum purpose (collector paraphrase): 사용자 정의 클래스의 validity 함수를 만들기 위해 S4Vectors의 setValidity2가 제공하는 방법을 읽는다.

Original context:
We define a validity method that enforces the constraints that we
described earlier. This is done by defining a validity function using
setValidity2 from the S4Vectors
package222 This allows us to turn off the validity checks in internal functions where intermediate objects may not be valid within the scope of the function..
Returning a string indicates that there is a problem and triggers an
error in the R session.
